tools.name: dc_projects
tools.description: US data center projects from public sources: MW, stage, power status, utility, opposition, source URLs. Filters: state (2-letter), county, stage, min_mw, limit (max 50). Costs 2 credits ($0.02) per call; needs an API key.

tools.name: dc_power
tools.description: Power and siting context by county: project count, known MW, power status mix, utilities, opposition count, sources. Filters: state, county, limit (max 50). Costs 1 credits ($0.01) per call; needs an API key.

tools.name: dc_deals
tools.description: Data center M&A, leasing and financing deals with public price and $/MW where disclosed, with sources. Filters: market, limit (max 50). Costs 3 credits ($0.03) per call; needs an API key.

tools.name: dc_legislation
tools.description: Data center bills, ordinances and moratoriums with status and next action, with sources. Filters: state, limit (max 50). Costs 1 credits ($0.01) per call; needs an API key.

tools.name: dc_sample
tools.description: Free: three example rows from each paid tool so you can see the data shape before buying credits.

tools.name: dc_pricing
tools.description: Free: prices per tool and how to buy credits.
